scope: Source-reviewed handheld software and game targets: GBA, Game Boy/Color, PSP, and Vita. Seven records across five repositories; no database import performed.

projects.title: GBA-Recomp
projects.platform: Game Boy Advance ROM → native Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android builds
projects.status: v0.4 release (2026-06-18); the ROM function-map database is a work in progress.
projects.summary: Rust static-recompilation tool and runtime translates user-supplied GBA ROMs to native executables, emitting C11 against a Rust ARM7TDMI hardware model. The maintainer reports 169,778 of an estimated 4.1 million functions mapped and one fully mapped game without identifying it. Android build dependencies are documented; no ROM, BIOS, or commercial game data is shipped.

projects.title: gb2swf
projects.platform: Game Boy / Game Boy Color ROM → SWF and offline HTML player (Ruffle)
projects.status: v1.0.0 release (2026-10-13); README reports seven open-licensed homebrew games tested in Ruffle.
projects.summary: Haxe tool profiles a user-supplied DMG/CGB ROM, translates observed basic blocks to SWF bytecode, and leaves unobserved or unsupported code to an interpreter fallback; generated offline HTML bundles a Ruffle player. The maintainer documents cartridge, timing, sound, and peripheral limitations. No game ROMs are included.

projects.title: psprism — PSP static-recompilation engine
projects.platform: PlayStation Portable ISO / ELF / PRX → native macOS and Windows; PSP testbench and partial overlays
projects.status: No tagged releases found (checked 2026-10-16); maintainer README reports macOS and Windows host backends working, with Linux planned.
projects.summary: C++20 static-recompilation framework lifts Allegrex MIPS executables to portable C++ and runs them through the Refract host compatibility layer. The PSP rebuild path is documented as a diagnostics, round-trip verification, and partial overlay/patching harness; full-game execution on PSP is limited by CPU and memory constraints.

projects.title: Daxter — psprism native macOS target
projects.status: Maintainer README calls Daxter fully playable on macOS; no tagged releases found as of 2026-10-16.
projects.summary: The psprism README shows Daxter running through its static PSP-to-C++20 translation and Refract macOS runtime and says Daxter is fully playable on macOS; other game profiles are work in progress. The PSP output path is for diagnostics and partial overlays, not the playable full-game target.

projects.title: Insaniquarium! Deluxe — PlayStation Vita port
projects.status: v1.00a release (2026-10-11); README reports approximately 36 FPS without overclocking and documents a keyboard/paused-game softlock.
projects.summary: The Vita loader maps the Android libmain.so into the Vita process, relocates imports against Vita-side libc/SDL/GL shims, runs C++ constructors, and calls SDL_main. It requires user-supplied game data and the Android ARMv7 library; the repository says it ships no game files. No license is declared for this repository.
projects.strategy: Android ARM ELF loading with Vita-side API shims

sources.label: Canonical game facts (article covers Deluxe edition)

projects.title: Epoch & Equinox — Oracle of Ages player
projects.game: The Legend of Zelda: Oracle of Ages
projects.platform: Game Boy Color → Windows, Linux, and macOS (Apple Silicon)
projects.status: v0.7.3 release (2026-09-18); current README identifies Oracle of Ages as supported by the shared player.
projects.summary: Cross-platform native player for a user-supplied Oracle of Ages ROM. The current README says the runtime interprets the loaded Game Boy Color ROM, like an emulator; earlier generated-C recompilation was removed after testing showed that generated code was not used. A separate native Ages reconstruction is a hidden developer preview, not the normal player.
projects.strategy: Game Boy Color ROM interpretation / emulation
